name: NG: Cursed in Love!?
source:
For his whole life, college student Hikaru can see what others couldn't. "Just pretend you can't see them. Do not try to meddle with the other side,"--through all these years, this is how he lived his life.

However, finding himself in a sudden need of cash to help his sister, he begrudingly accepted a gig to accompany his streamer friend. But Hikaru soon realized that maybe he shouldn't have accepted the offer in the first place; for he might not have come home alone from the trip...

[From [url=https://sp-abang.itch.io/ng-cursed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学生光一生都能看到别人看不到的东西。“就装作看不见吧，别去干涉对方。”——这么多年，他就是这样过着自己的生活。

然而，他发现自己突然需要现金来帮助他的妹妹，他不情愿地接受了一份陪伴他的主播朋友的演出。但光很快意识到，也许他一开始就不应该接受这个提议；因为他可能不会独自旅行回家……

[来自[url=https://sp-abang.itch.io/ng-cursed]itch.io[/url]]
